description: Current FFmpeg built with NVENC API 13.0 for NVIDIA GPUs and legacy driver branches.
notes: Uses nv-codec-headers 13.0 / NVENC API 13.0 for legacy NVIDIA driver compatibility.
The package exposes the same ffmpeg, ffprobe and ffplay commands as the standard Scoop ffmpeg package. Remove or switch the other package if its shims take precedence.
